references.text: The Ten Commandments in Exodus contain the same commandments that Jesus mentions.
The Ten Commandments are repeated and expanded upon in Deuteronomy, reflecting the same principles Jesus mentions.
The Book of Psalms contains ethical and moral principles similar to those Jesus mentions, especially regarding honesty and justice.
In the Sermon on the Mount in Matthew, Jesus repeats and expands upon some of the same commandments.
John's account of the woman caught in adultery reflects Jesus' teaching on not judging and on forgiveness, which aligns with the commandment against committing adultery.
Paul summarizes the law in Romans by mentioning the command to love, which includes the principles Jesus mentions.
